blocker named. Do not start one, and do not offer one as the next step — it becomes work only

`state=ready` on work that is actually blocked passes everything here.

0 row(s) recorded `done` and 0 dispositioned `n/a`. They are not work and are listed here

## What this file cannot see

Scanned **869 file(s)**, and `scripts/pipeline-lint.php` now gates this file on every push —
it refuses a hand edit, a roadmap phase claiming work in flight without naming a live row,
a second queue, a held row missing from either this line or the stop-list that guards
unattended work, and a documented column that exists, is used by nothing, and is scheduled
nowhere.

⛔ **It is still a floor rather than a census, and the remaining gap is narrower than it
was rather than closed.** The gate proves that what IS written down is queued and
consistent. It cannot prove that everything worth writing down has been: an obligation
living only in a document no rule reads is still invisible here, and the coverage rules
that widen which documents count are the increment after this one.
